description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2022: Multi-Directional Cyber-Physical Experimental Testing to Establish Multi-natural Hazard Resiliency of Structural Systems and Building Content Hazard Mitigation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Philip Harvey, University of Oklahoma (ou.edu). Protecting both the essential building contents and the structural system (as well as facilitating and accelerating the post-event functionality of business operations) is a major concern during natural hazards. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fvgg-9h66. Keywords: Lehigh University NHERI Experimental Facility, real-time hybrid simulation, critical non-structural equipment, seismic isolation, non-linear fluid viscous dampers, soil-foundation-structure interaction. Published 2023-04-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
